name: reflect-bridge
description: Reflect, adapted: spots reusable corrections in your short prompts (one small Haiku call, only on prompts that read like a correction) and saves them on one press to auto-memory, the shared Claude CLAUDE.md, or the AGENTS.md all your agents read. Based on claude-reflect's mod by Bayram Annakov (MIT).

model.title: Check model
model.description: The model that reads a correction-like prompt and decides whether it is a reusable rule
